verdict.rationale: Tracking opt-out is a fair question for a government web portal, since such sites can offer cookie or analytics opt-outs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only privacy-related item is a general statement that OHID logins are protected by digital security standards, which is a related assurance rather than an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
